column1: # ZAP rule overrides for the DAST job: these alerts fail the build; every other alert is a warning (see the report artifact).
# 40014 also fires, at low confidence, when stored text such as <script> comes back inside JSON. JSON is not
# rendered as HTML and the web app never inserts raw HTML (its tests and semgrep's React rules check that),
# so it is a warning here; reflected XSS (40012) stays a failure.
# 2026-10-16: 40018 fired once on /levels/ for ?ordering=ordering+AND+1=1+-- while an earlier run of the same code
# passed. Replayed: the 1=1 and 1=2 responses are identical (DRF keeps only known ordering fields); the scanner's
# own concurrent POSTs of "ZAP" levels changed the list between its requests. test_ordering_never_reaches_sql
# checks ZAP's payloads on every list endpoint in every CI run. Out of scope for this one URL only.
